capabilities: Create one workout note per day from muscle groups defined in settings
Append exercise tables via a dropdown picker with per-exercise defaults
Score training volume including drop sets, isometric holds, bands, and bodyweight
Auto-fill weight columns from the last session and bulk-set weights per exercise
Render a spiral chart of daily volume, filterable by muscle group
extras: The manifest carries the standard notice that the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to log workouts in structured tables or compute training volume from them.
summary: Workout logger that creates daily Markdown-table notes per muscle group and charts training volume (weight times reps) as a spiral visualization.
